intro.words: A Video.js 10 skin / shaped like a **book.**

beats.label: The brass clasp
beats.line: Stop closes the book at its first page.

beats.label: The page corners
beats.line: Press again and they add up: +10, +20, +30.

beats.label: The line-markers
beats.line: A leaf sweeps across the plate · Shift + ← / →

beats.label: The silk ribbon
beats.line: The pages riffle, the plate leans, the folio is printed large.

beats.label: The folio
beats.line: p. 150 of 888 — a page a second, the clock set beneath.

beats.label: The inkwell
beats.line: The ink level is the volume · M

beats.label: The magnifier
beats.line: Subtitles: English above, your language beneath.

beats.label: The compass dial
beats.line: Eight languages, from Sintel’s own subtitles.

beats.label: The open book
beats.line: F from the keyboard · Esc to close

beats.label: Keyboard
beats.line: Tab through the desk · a gold-foil focus ring · ? opens the guide
